title: 有馬記念の後に・まさかの二強超え

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek defeats Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross to win the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the post-race interview, she reflects on our hardships and how those trials have helped us grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells the reporters that for her next goal, she would like to take part in a race she has always dreamed of—the Osaka Hai.
